variants.why_semantic: Payment is a meaningful checkout step title, but the saved route, heading, and product-browsing content establish that the current state is the Products page.
variants.seeded_behavior: On the Products route, keep the route, h1, product cards, navigation, language, landmarks, controls, and page structure unchanged but change the document title to Payment | Brightlane Checkout.
variants.baseline_behavior: The Products route has document title Products | Brightlane Checkout and visible Products content.

context.expected_products_context: Featured products, product cards, and current cart summary are visible.

variants.validation_approach: Run the Checkout co-sem-058 focused acquisition, inspect page-title evidence on the Products state, build page-title-not-descriptive candidates, and match the page candidate with title Payment | Brightlane Checkout on route /products while visible Products content remains unchanged.

context.expected_progress_state: Shipping address is the current checkout step.

context.expected_shipping_context: Shipping details form with shipping-address fields is visible.
context.expected_progress_state: Shipping address is the current checkout step.
